entries.summary: Rust str::to_lowercase applies full Unicode case mapping, lowering U+0130 to i + U+0307; Go's strings.ToLower applies simple per-rune mapping and drops the combining dot.
Rust str::to_uppercase expands U+00DF to SS; Go's per-rune uppercase leaves it unchanged.
urlencode is a Go-port default (defaults.go:13-130) but BAML does not enable the urlencode feature, so the engine rejects it. A Go-only extra must not become a supported BAML behaviour.

dict() builds a mapping from keyword arguments, and Rust keeps the order they were written in. This fork passes keyword arguments to functions and filters as a Go map (value.Callable, filters.Filter), so the order is lost at the call boundary, before the function can preserve it. Ordered map values fixed every other mapping surface; this one needs the callable signature to carry an ordered mapping.
